---
name: Documentation Request
about: Report missing, unclear, or outdated documentation
title: '[Docs]: '
labels: documentation, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## Which Documentation Is Missing or Unclear?

Name the file (e.g. `README.md`, `docs/api.md`, `docs/architecture.md`) or describe the topic that has no documentation home yet.

## What Should It Cover?

List the specific questions a reader should be able to answer after reading it (setup steps, environment variables, API routes, data model concepts, etc.).

## Who Benefits?

- [ ] First-time contributors getting set up locally
- [ ] Frontend contributors (apps/web)
- [ ] Backend contributors (apps/api)
- [ ] Operators/deployers (Docker, env config, GCS/storage)
- [ ] End users
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Additional Context

Links to related code, existing partial docs, or related issues.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The doc gap is filled or the existing doc is corrected.
- [ ] Content is grounded in the current codebase (no speculative/aspirational claims presented as fact).
- [ ] Relevant docs cross-link to each other (e.g. README links to the new doc).
